documents.title: /checkout API contract
documents.text: The /checkout customer_note field accepts free text, including apostrophes and SQL examples. All queries use bound parameters. This is a contract, not proof that a particular request is safe.

documents.title: /checkout deployment record
documents.text: The current release adds customer_note. A staging reproduction of the legitimate note "select a gift" was blocked by SQL-942. The previous request without that field passed. Production request contents still need verification.
